environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in production VPC with task role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/microservice-prod-role. The role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::prod-data-* and s3:GetObject on all buckets. No permission boundary attached. No SCP applied to the account. The service is exposed via NLB on port 8080 with no authentication layer in front.

config.s3_policy: Allow s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::prod-data-*, Allow s3:GetObject on *
